messages:
sam.marketing: Quick post-launch snapshot — noticed lead intake dip after yesterday's webinar. Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.ai/launch-xyz :eyes:

jess_growth: Where exactly? conversion funnel or source attribution? :thinking_face:

tom_analytics: Funnel. Top-line: webinar traffic -> signup conversion down ~12% last 24h. Attribution shows more 'unknown' medium vs last week. Raw query:
```sql
SELECT source, count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY source ORDER BY 2 DESC;
```

maria_salesops: Could be routing throttles — HubSpot flow 'webinar_default' had a recent rule change. Checking now.

sam.marketing: Thanks — also noticed spikes in bounce rate on the landing page around 10:30-11:15 PT.

maria_salesops: Confirmed: someone updated the 'assign owner' condition yesterday. If owner null -> routing to round-robin, but there's a bug sending to archived queues.

jess_growth: Ugh. That would cause leads to stall and fall out of funnel. Any quick rollback option?

maria_salesops: I can revert the rule. Will do it if tom says it's likely the cause.

tom_analytics: Correlation looks strong. If we revert, monitor these two KPIs: 'new_leads', 'first_response_time' over next 2 hours. I'll open a small dashboard panel.

sam.marketing: Plan: maria revert -> tom watch -> jess report to growth channel if recovery >8% within 2h. If not, escalate to eng for landing page artifact. Agreed?

jess_growth: Agreed. I'll draft the short comms for the sales inbox so reps aren't confused.

pipeline-bot: Routing rule 'webinar_default' reverted by maria_salesops at 2025-08-12 16:12:34 UTC :white_check_mark:

tom_analytics: Early signal: new_leads up 9% in first 30m. Looks like routing was the issue. Keeping an eye for the next hour.

sam.marketing: Awesome — thanks team. Add to weekly KPI review notes: incident 1778888888-routing-surge as post-launch learnings. We'll include TL;DR and recommended ownership change.

jess_growth: I'll add to the KPI deck and note the attribution caveat (last-touch overstates unknown when routing misfires).
